updates.title: 主工作区交互与搜索优化
updates.titleEn: Workspace interactions and search optimization
items: 为任务搜索建立快照索引和关键词缓存，减少大量子任务下的等待。任务名、备注、标签和子任务仍可匹配。
恢复按清单分组的搜索结果和组内顺序。搜索时留出完整结果区域，仍显示已完成任务和缺少清单的匹配项。
搜索保留 300 毫秒防抖和回车立即提交，支持中文输入法合成、清空后按 Escape 返回，以及保留仍匹配的详情。通知和其他导航可取消等待中的搜索。
还原创建框的明暗主题文字颜色，主任务和子任务可点击加号或按回车创建。创建框和日期选择使用同一个已保存的默认到期日。
任务拖动时侧栏显示合法目标和悬停反馈。清单夹按清单分组时可在同一清单内排序，日期聚合区禁止内部排序。
分组标题随任务移动。任务放置成功并离开当前视图时，拖影朝目标退场。
恢复报表顶部三项的悬停番茄统计格式，修复详情日期快捷按钮的高亮和未来七天提示。详情和右键菜单共用删除确认与处理流程。
itemsEn: Index tasks and subtasks per snapshot and cache normalized queries to speed up searches with large subtask collections. Task names, notes, tags, and subtasks remain searchable.
Group search results in list order and preserve task order within each group. Give the results the full workspace area and keep matches for completed tasks and tasks without an available list.

Keep the 300 ms debounce and immediate Enter action. Search waits for IME composition to finish, Escape returns after clearing, and matching task details stay open. Notifications and other navigation cancel pending searches.
Restore the light and dark composer text colors. Clicking the plus button or pressing Enter creates tasks and subtasks. The composer and picker share the saved default due date.
Highlight eligible sidebar targets while dragging a task. A folder grouped by list allows reordering within the same list, and date aggregates prevent internal reordering.
Move group headings with task rows. When a successful drop takes a task out of the current view, its drag preview exits toward the target.

Restore the pomodoro counts shown when hovering over the three time totals in Reports. Fix inspector date shortcut highlighting and the Next 7 Days tooltip. The inspector and context menu share the same deletion flow.

updates.title: 关于页面视觉统一与发布流程优化
updates.titleEn: About settings and release workflow improvements
items: 按主要主题组织每个版本，使用语义化版本号。当前开发批次记录主题、范围和验收要求，发布时整理为中英文版本报告。
按引用身份复用同一提交的原始 CI 矩阵及附件。预检与独立门禁仍校验版本、构建、来源和摘要。
设置的关于页恢复双列设置行，依次显示版本、作者、来源、许可、本地数据与官方渠道。窄窗口下内容可换行和滚动。
恢复原版 GitHub 仓库图标。六个平台图标共用悬停高亮和键盘焦点反馈，并打开对应官方渠道。
在官方下载后加入官方网站和支持正版说明，明确本地项目与官方发行的身份。
itemsEn: Organize each release around one main theme and use semantic versioning. Record the theme, scope, and acceptance criteria for the current batch and summarize its changes in bilingual release reports.
Reuse the original CI matrix and artifacts for the exact commit according to ref identity. Preflight and the independent gate still check version, build, provenance, and digests.
Restore two-column settings rows in About for the version, author, upstream project, licenses, local data, and official channels. Content wraps and scrolls in narrow windows.
Restore the original GitHub repository icon. The six platform icons share its hover and keyboard focus feedback and open the corresponding official channels.
Add the official website and a note supporting the official app below the downloads, with clear attribution for the local edition.

updates.title: 备份、时间处理与界面修复
updates.titleEn: Backup, time handling, and interface fixes
items: 备份检查和恢复共用目标历史校验，提前拒绝损坏记录和非文本名称，保留旧版缺名记录与兼容字段。
任务完成或删除首次发现待确认的计时中断时，回滚任务、子任务和计时写入。确认中断后可重试。
每日专注目标按本地自然日更新。夏令时回拨期间修改日程和专注记录的时长会保留原来的开始时刻。
跨标签页合并提醒已读记录。系统通知失败时保留应用内未读状态，后续提醒仍按时调度。
恢复独立迷你计时器的背景亮度、入场淡入和窗口按钮，缩放时保持计时控件居中。
设置下拉按钮的点击范围和可见控件一致，将外观中的壁纸区域更名为背景。
恢复计时侧栏 330px 卡片的 150ms 线性滑动，以及计时组件松手后的 180ms ease-out 双轴排序过渡。
调整关于页的版本、来源项目和许可说明。更新详情只滚动更新条目，固定标题、应用磁贴与确认区。
专注时长报表按任务优先级和顺序排列任务，再按保存顺序排列自定义清单。短分段沿设备像素边界绘制。
恢复导入导出窗口的标题和正文间距。番茄记录滚动时仅移动对应滚动条，编辑记录后直接更新分段。
itemsEn: Backup inspection and restore share goal history validation. Both reject corrupt entries and non-text names while preserving older records with omitted names and compatibility fields.
Completing or deleting a task rolls back task, subtask, and timer writes if detaching the timer first finds an interruption awaiting confirmation. The action can be retried after confirmation.
Daily focus goals update by local calendar date. Editing the duration of a schedule or focus record during the daylight saving fall-back preserves its original start instant.
Merge reminder acknowledgements across tabs. A system notification failure preserves the unread reminder in the app and leaves subsequent reminders scheduled.
Restore the native mini timer's background brightness, opening fade, and window buttons. Timer controls stay centered when resized.
Limit settings dropdown clicks to the visible controls and rename the wallpaper section in Appearance to Background.
Restore the 150 ms linear slide of the timer sidebar's 330 px cards and the 180 ms ease-out reorder transition along both axes after dropping a timer widget.
Clarify the version, upstream project, and licensing in About. Update details scroll the entries while keeping the title, app tile, and confirmation area fixed.
In focus duration charts, sort tasks by priority and task order, followed by custom lists in saved order. Align short segment boundaries to device pixels.
Restore title and content spacing in the import and export windows. Scrolling focus records moves the corresponding scrollbar, and saving an edit updates chart segments in place.

updates.title: 日程交互、工作区动画与本地安全
updates.titleEn: Calendar interactions, workspace motion, and local security
items: 日程任务面板和时间轴同步收展。同一个加号平移并旋转成叉号，连按可从中途反向，支持减少动态效果。
计划卡片沿用清单配色和应用样式，按实际宽高优先显示任务名称，再显示起止时间。完整信息可在提示或详情中查看。
拖动已有安排时在上层实时显示起止时间并保留时长。移动或用原拖动柄调整时长后，从预览直接衔接到保存结果。写入失败和并发冲突时平滑回滚。
从任务面板拖入日程时，浮动卡片显示任务名称、时长、放置状态和实时预计开始时间。滚动、缩放和跨午夜时，实际安排与预览一致。
恢复普通和重复任务的完成反馈。任务、自定义清单、系统清单和计时器组件的拖动或方向键排序从当前可见位置接续，写入失败时恢复已保存顺序。
完成任务报表分别排列任务类别和自定义清单。清单夹的新建任务菜单校验直属可见清单。导出窗口使用圆角内的共享滚动条。
正式版和隔离预览校验内联启动代码的哈希。本地 Node 和 Python 启动器禁止嵌入并校验请求范围和运行清单。
备份和导入前安全副本省略外部联网许可。导入保留主题与缓存壁纸，设置日志缺少目标时恢复原数据及本地许可。
修复 HMR 的 React 开发运行时和 Linux 浏览器镜像校验。CI 固定 Actions 与 Playwright 镜像，并核验附件大小和首次发布分支来源。旧版成就恢复测试排除界面轮询竞态。
itemsEn: The calendar task pane and timeline resize together. One plus moves and rotates into a cross, reverses mid-animation on repeated clicks, and respects reduced motion.
Scheduled cards use list colors and shared app styling. Their actual size determines when to show the name and start and end times. Tooltips and details show the full information.

A moved plan stays above other cards and shows live start and end times while preserving its duration. Moves and resizes with the existing handle continue from the preview to the saved result, with smooth rollback after a write failure or concurrent edit.
Dragging from the task pane shows the name, duration, placement status, and live prospective start time. The saved range follows the preview across scrolling, zoom, and midnight.

Restore completion feedback for ordinary and repeating tasks. Drag and arrow-key reordering for tasks, custom lists, system lists, and timer widgets continue from painted positions, with failed writes returning to the saved order.
Order task categories and custom lists separately in the completed-task chart. Validate visible direct lists in a folder's new-task picker. Use the shared scrollbar inside rounded export dialogs.
Check inline startup code hashes in production and isolated previews. The local Node and Python launchers prevent framing and validate the request scope and runtime manifest.
Backups and pre-import safety copies omit external networking consent. Import preserves themes and cached wallpapers. Restore original data and local consent when a settings journal lacks its target.

Fix the HMR React development runtime and Linux browser image validation. CI pins Actions and the Playwright image and verifies artifact size limits and first-publication branch provenance. The legacy achievement restore test avoids racing UI polling.

updates.title: 清单夹任务、弹窗与迷你计时器修复
updates.titleEn: Folder tasks, dialogs, and mini timer fixes
items: 清单夹按直属可见清单显示任务。创建任务时按所在页面显示清单选择和到期日控件，恢复下拉菜单图标尺寸与外部点击关闭。
替换应用标识并为高 DPI 提供原始图像。删除数据与更新详情显示左上角应用磁贴。导入预览在圆角内使用统一的可拖动滚动条。
点击通知面板外部可收起，同时执行被点击的操作。独立迷你计时器保持紧凑排版，并与主窗口共用计时会话。
Windows 隔离预览增加临时 Edge 会话和静态备用模式，启动与渲染错误可复制诊断信息。预览保留独立存储并恢复 HMR 刷新快捷键。
导入后恢复有效内嵌头像，任务完成音内嵌以避免下载管理器拦截。修复 Python 备用服务启动延迟和报表动画测试的时钟竞态。
统一 HMR 启动页和应用的版本来源，保留已有预览数据。CI 提前核验 Tag 与版本，仅在证实较新的失败由错误 Tag 版本引起时继续复用同一提交的 dev 验证证据。
itemsEn: Show folder tasks grouped by visible direct lists. Restore list and due-date controls by view, the list picker icon dimensions, and outside-click dismissal.
Use original application icon assets for high-DPI displays. Add a tile to data deletion and update details. Keep the shared draggable scrollbar inside the rounded import preview.
Dismiss notifications on outside clicks while allowing the clicked action to proceed. Keep the mini timer compact and on the same timing session as the main window.
Open Windows previews in a disposable Edge session and offer a static fallback. Copy startup and rendering diagnostics, retain isolated storage, and restore the HMR refresh shortcut.
Restore valid embedded avatars after import and bundle the completion sound to avoid download interception. Fix Python fallback startup latency and a clock race in report animation tests.
Use one release metadata source for HMR startup and keep preview data. Check the tag early in CI and preserve exact-commit dev evidence when a newer failure is proven to be a tag version mismatch.

updates.title: 任务完成提示音与启动可靠性
updates.titleEn: Task completion sound and reliable startup
items: 番茄钟设置中的「提示音」新增任务完成开关，继续共用音量。拖动结束后试听当前音量，两个铃声清单将「无」放在首位。
启动界面显示实际准备进度，等待必要资源和本地初始化完成。便携包可通过相对路径离线加载标签页图标。Vite 开发预览可正确加载启动图标。
导入后刷新头像，通知与导入界面复用统一滚动条。修复日程通知遮挡、更新确认按钮居中，并统一中断时间弹窗。
恢复任务右栏底部的 24×24 图标及到期日的星期和过期标红，将设置文案改为「新任务添加至其他任务上方」。
增加了更清晰的图标。
通用设置按语言、新任务顺序、通知和功能开关排列。任务完成提示音统一在番茄钟设置的「提示音」中调整。
收取阳光时保持一键收取按钮状态稳定。启用外部联网且选用 Bing 每日壁纸时，自动刷新过期图片。
itemsEn: Toggle task completion sounds under Alert sounds and keep the shared volume. Volume feedback plays after adjustment, and both alarm lists put None first.

Startup shows readiness progress for required assets and local initialization. The portable browser icon loads offline through a relative URL. The Vite development preview loads the startup icon correctly.

Refresh the profile avatar after import, share scrollbars across import and notifications, fix notifications over the calendar, center the update confirmation, and use the standard interruption dialog.
Restore the task sidebar’s 24×24 footer icons, weekday labels and red overdue dates, and clarify the setting for adding new tasks above other tasks.
Added clearer icons.
General settings group language, new-task order, notifications, and feature switches. Task completion sound is configured under Pomodoro alert sounds.
Keep Collect all stable during sunlight collection and automatically refresh expired Bing daily wallpapers when selected and external networking is enabled.

updates.title: 设置交互、主题与头像可靠性修复
updates.titleEn: Settings, theme and avatar reliability fixes
items: 统一默认头像与无效图片回退，更新详情使用标准弹窗和确定按钮。
修复设置与主题切换反馈、菜单开合及选中标识，优化主题图片预加载。
恢复旧版铃声选项试听与音量提示音，改进滑块精度并复用自定义滚动条。
简体中文标题随实际版本更新，取消头像上传或数据导入时保留设置。
修复视觉对照对新弹窗字体加载的竞态，保留严格像素断言；发布复用同提交已验证的 CI 与原始产物。
itemsEn: Share default avatars and invalid-image fallbacks; use the standard update dialog with an OK button.
Fix settings and theme feedback, dropdown toggling and selected marks, and preload theme images.
Restore ringtone option previews and volume feedback, improve slider precision and share custom scrollbars.
Use the current version in the Simplified Chinese title and preserve settings when uploads or imports are cancelled.
Synchronize visual comparisons with newly requested dialog fonts without relaxing pixel assertions; reuse verified exact-commit CI and original tested archives.

updates.title: 独立 React 应用与界面还原
updates.titleEn: Independent React app and interface restoration
items: 从完整 React / TypeScript 源码构建，保留本地任务、计时、日程、森林与备份。
修复报表首次布局、已完成记录卡片、运行图标和专注森林开关。
统一确认弹窗与版本信息，移除旧版运行实现和过时工具，按正式架构整理中英文文档。
itemsEn: Build from complete React/TypeScript sources with local tasks, timer, calendar, forest and backups.
Correct initial report layout, completed cards, active-task icons and the forest feature switch.
Unify dialogs and version metadata, remove the legacy runtime and obsolete tools, and document the production architecture in both languages.

updates.title: 修正文档与正式发布流程
updates.titleEn: Correct documentation and stable release workflow
items: 修复上一版本中长期开发分支名称和归档版本说明的文档错误。
版本 Tag 通过验证后直接发布为正式版并设为 Latest。
itemsEn: Correct documentation errors in the previous version concerning the long-lived development branch and archived version.
Publish a verified version tag directly as a stable Release and mark it Latest.

updates.title: 全屏交互回退与发布规则修正
updates.titleEn: Restore expanded timer controls and correct release rules
items: 保留全屏下拉按钮的原位置、图标和页内收起行为，小窗入口仅在浮动计时条。
长期开发使用 feature/2.0.0-versioning；中英文规范均禁止复用任何已推送的版本 Tag。
itemsEn: Preserve the expanded timer collapse control and keep the mini-window entry on the floating bar.
Use feature/2.0.0-versioning for ongoing development; both maintenance guides forbid reusing any pushed version tag.

updates.title: 恢复全屏计时器原交互
updates.titleEn: Restore original expanded timer controls
items: 恢复全屏下拉按钮的原位置、图标和收起行为；小窗入口仅保留在浮动计时条。
取消自行增加的开发分支命名条款；失败候选也使用递增的新版本 Tag。
itemsEn: Restore the expanded timer collapse control to its original position, icon and behavior; keep the mini-window entry on the floating bar.
Remove the invented development branch naming rule and require fresh patch-version tags for failed candidates.

updates.title: 官方小窗样式与专用入口
updates.titleEn: Official mini timer styling and a dedicated entry
items: 小窗口复用官方 Windows 7.2.2 的紧凑计时条、圆形计时盘与图标控制。
原计时器角落按钮移到右上角，左上角加入官方小窗口按钮。
只有点击左上角小按钮才请求独立小窗口，展开、收起和双击保持页内操作。
itemsEn: Reuse the official Windows 7.2.2 compact timer, circular dial and icon controls.
Move existing corner controls to the upper right and add the official mini-window button on the upper left.
Only the dedicated upper-left button requests a mini window; expanding, collapsing and double-clicking stay in-page.

updates.title: 外部联网开关、壁纸可靠性与迷你计时窗口
items: 通用功能开关新增默认关闭的外部联网（实验性）；关闭时点击 Bing 每日主题显示开启提示。
壁纸请求拒绝重定向，支持跨日刷新、取消请求及已保存图片的离线恢复。
主题编辑复用维护事务锁，检测跨标签冲突，保留旧备份兼容。
支持的浏览器可打开迷你计时窗口，复用原计时控制；不支持时回退页内浮动计时器。
未读版本更新显示红点；恢复默认排序按钮保持稳定外观与正常光标。
updates.titleEn: External networking, reliable wallpapers and a mini timer
itemsEn: Add an external networking (experimental) switch, off by default, using the existing bottom toast when selecting Bing daily while disabled.
Reject wallpaper redirects, refresh across days, cancel requests and restore saved images offline.
Protect theme changes with the existing maintenance transaction lock and detect cross-tab conflicts, retaining backup compatibility.
Open a mini timer on supported browsers using the existing timer commands, with an in-page fallback.
Mark unread release updates with the shared badge and keep the Restore default order button visually stable.

updates.title: 审查修复与提醒显示优化
items: 加强计时备份校验，防止损坏数据覆盖现有记录。
日程编辑检测跨标签冲突，避免覆盖新修改或恢复已删除安排。
修复网络请求取消、大量提醒与奖励处理、休息恢复显示及 Python 启动服务。
修复一键收取阳光动画结束后的原位闪现，保留失败重试。
优化任务提醒的日期边距、行间距和长标题换行。
updates.titleEn: Audit fixes and reminder layout improvements
itemsEn: Validate timer backups before replacing existing records.
Detect cross-tab schedule conflicts and prevent stale edits from restoring deleted plans.
Fix cancelled network requests, large reminder and reward collections, break recovery display and the Python server.
Prevent sunlight from flashing back after collection animations while preserving retries.
Improve reminder date padding, line spacing and long-title wrapping.

updates.title: 森林一键收取、共用控件与可靠性修复
items: 森林红点随阳光成熟、过期和数据变化自动刷新，无需先打开森林。
新增手形一键收取入口，与成就、攻略复用圆形按钮样式。
梳理全体样式并复用按钮、开关、番茄图标、日期与下拉控件，统一语言菜单。
确定从 2.0.0 起使用独立三段式版本，提供清晰的实施计划；1.8.2 继续旧版本格式。
导入前完整校验计时快照的休息参数及自动切换选项，拒绝无效配置。
本地服务对包含空字符的请求返回错误，避免服务意外退出。
修复英文日程当天标题，正确显示 Today。
updates.titleEn: Forest collect all, shared controls and reliability fixes
itemsEn: Refresh the forest badge as sunlight matures, expires or changes, without opening the forest.
Collect available sunlight with a hand button sharing the achievement and guide button style.
Audit all styles and reuse button, switch, pomodoro, date and dropdown controls, matching the language menu to other settings.
Adopt independent three-part application versions starting with 2.0.0 and provide a practical implementation plan; 1.8.2 retains the current format.
Validate all timer snapshot break settings and automation flags before import, rejecting invalid configurations.
Reject request paths containing NUL bytes without terminating the local server.
Show Today correctly in the English schedule day header.

updates.title: 计时恢复与本地运行可靠性修复
items: 系统时间回退后，计时备份仍可恢复，保留已专注时长。
中断休息选择不继续时保持暂停，恢复后继续剩余休息。
收紧本地服务访问和壁纸地址校验，修复跨月日程验收。
updates.titleEn: Timer recovery and local runtime reliability fixes
itemsEn: Restore timer backups after a system clock rollback while retaining completed focus time.
Keep an interrupted break paused when continuation is declined, and resume its remaining rest time.
Validate local server access and wallpaper addresses, and fix calendar acceptance across months.

updates.title: Windows 发布环境修复与维护规则
items: 关于页提供中英文图文教程，覆盖任务、计时、日程和备份。
修复取消资源下载后的文件流清理，改善 Windows 发布验收环境与失败诊断。
完善后续正式版本留档规则，保留历史版本原有文档和记录。
updates.titleEn: Windows release environment and maintenance rules
itemsEn: Open illustrated Chinese and English guides from About.
Close streams after cancelled downloads and improve Windows release acceptance resources and failure diagnostics.
Apply formal release documentation rules prospectively, preserving existing historical records.

updates.title: 本地专注森林、成就与任务提醒
items: 恢复原版专注森林、阳光收取和详细攻略，森林数据保存在本机。
新增铜、银、金三档本地成就，达成后直接获得阳光奖励。
取消每日阳光收取上限，修复连续收取与位置刷新。
修复网页标签图标，并突出圆形成就入口。
阳光沿原版路径飞向树木，收取失败可重试，兼容减少动态效果。
任务到时提醒优先展示，已读或完成后及时清除红点，保留版本更新提示。
可选的浏览器存储持久化授权在后台执行，不再阻塞应用启动。
updates.titleEn: Local Focus forest, achievements and task reminders
itemsEn: Restore the original Focus forest, sunlight collection and detailed guide, with local storage.
Earn bronze, silver and gold local achievements with immediate sunlight rewards.
Remove the daily collection limit and fix sunlight collection and position refresh.
Fix the browser tab icon and make the achievements entry a prominent circular button.
Animate sunlight along the original flight path, retry failed collections and respect reduced motion.
Show task reminders before release history and clear read or completed reminder badges while retaining release notifications.
Request optional browser storage persistence in the background without blocking startup.

updates.title: 日程与提示样式优化
items: 日程创建任务时为空名称提供清晰的表单提示。
底部提示适配浅色和深色主题，并自动渐隐。
updates.titleEn: Schedule and notice refinements
itemsEn: Show an inline message when a schedule task has no name.
Adapt bottom notices to light and dark themes and fade them out automatically.

updates.title: 本地日程与官方 7.2.2 兼容功能
items: 日程支持拖选创建任务、重叠布局、原生日期及番茄清单控件。
日程作为系统清单支持排序隐藏，月视图支持滚动和查看记录。
日程文字以原侧边栏为基准调整，其他区域保持原样。
短专注记录显示秒数，新增下周到期快捷操作。
updates.titleEn: Local schedule and compatible 7.2.2 features
itemsEn: Create tasks by selecting schedule time, with overlap layout and native date, pomodoro and project controls.
Manage Schedule as a sortable, hideable list and scroll the month view.
Align schedule typography with the unchanged sidebar.
Display short focus in seconds and add the due-next-week shortcut.

updates.title: 系统清单排序与用户名存储修复
items: 系统清单改用界面内拖动，禁放位置不再触发浏览器文本搜索，主动移动行显示在动画上层。
清单管理取消自定义清单排序，自定义清单继续在主界面拖动。
新增恢复系统清单默认排序按钮，保留隐藏状态和自定义清单数据。
清理已停用的 NAME Cookie，用户名统一从本地存储读取。
updates.titleEn: System list ordering and username storage fixes
itemsEn: Use in-app dragging for system lists without browser text-search gestures, keeping the moved row above other rows.
Remove custom-list ordering from settings; continue reordering custom lists in the main view.
Restore the default system list order while preserving hidden states and custom-list data.
Remove the unused NAME browser cookie and read usernames from local storage.

updates.title: 清单排序反馈与本地兼容修复
items: 清单每行新增三条杠拖动手柄、排序动画和插入提示，拖动时不可放置的清单分组变灰。
改善背景音的多窗口交接；缺少 Web Locks 时说明兼容限制，保留试听与完成提示音。
本地昵称和头像直接通过数据服务保存，写入失败时正确反馈。
updates.titleEn: List ordering feedback and local compatibility fixes
itemsEn: Add visible three-bar drag handles, reorder animation and insertion feedback; dim lists in the unavailable group while dragging.
Improve background-audio handoff between windows; explain the fallback without Web Locks while retaining previews and completion sounds.
Save local names and avatars through the data service and report failed writes.

updates.title: 字体、清单排序与滚动修复
items: 英文附带字体加载完成后自动应用，恢复组件各自的字体样式。
设置中的系统清单与自定义清单分别支持拖动和键盘排序，并保存顺序。
修复清单管理底部出现双滚动条的问题。
改善本地网络兼容，修复复用请求时的同源访问。
updates.titleEn: Fonts, list ordering and scrolling fixes
itemsEn: Apply the bundled English font when ready while retaining individual component fonts.
Reorder system and custom lists separately by dragging or keyboard; the order is saved.
Fix the extra scrollbar in list management.
Improve local network compatibility for reused same-origin requests.

updates.title: 语言字体、功能整合与发布验收修复
items: 中文附带字体就绪后自动应用，英文优先系统西文字体，番茄钟保留官方字体。
按功能整合数据、备份、设置和主题服务，移除无效轮询与调试入口。
保留渐进启动和真实进度，界面就绪后显示，加载失败时可重试。
完善跨标签协同验收，提供跨平台便携包与 SHA256 校验。
updates.titleEn: Language fonts, feature consolidation and release verification
itemsEn: Apply bundled Chinese fonts when ready, prefer western system fonts in English, and retain official timer fonts.
Consolidate data, backup, settings and theme services, removing unused polling and debug controls.
Keep progressive startup and real progress, show the workspace when ready, and retry failed loads.
Improve cross-tab verification and provide portable packages with SHA256 verification.

updates.title: 渐进启动与加载反馈
items: 启动先显示轻量骨架与真实步骤进度，核心界面就绪后进入。
中英文复用已有词库，其他语言异步读取，长等待或失败时可重试。
启动反馈支持深色、窄屏、减少动态效果与无 JavaScript 提示。
updates.titleEn: Progressive startup and loading feedback
itemsEn: See a lightweight first screen and real step progress, then enter when the core workspace is ready.
Reuse Chinese and English catalogs, load other locales asynchronously, and retry long or failed loads.
Use startup feedback with dark appearance, narrow screens, reduced motion and a no-JavaScript explanation.

updates.title: 语言选择、英文适配与通知授权
items: 通用设置新增跟随系统、简体中文和English，其他语言仅通过跟随系统启用。
本地界面、错误、历史更新和使用维护文档新增英语；缺失翻译回退合适语言，不显示键名。
新增主动通知授权和测试入口，统一纯本地功能定位与小组、森林设计方案。
updates.titleEn: Language selection, English support and notifications
itemsEn: Choose Follow system, Simplified Chinese or English in General settings. Other existing languages remain available through Follow system.
Use English local dialogs, errors, release notes and documentation, with readable fallbacks for missing translations.
Enable or test desktop notifications explicitly, and clarify the offline scope and group/forest design.

updates.title: 每日壁纸缓存与主题设置恢复
items: 每日壁纸优先使用缓存，过期时后台刷新，首次下载期间关闭设置仍会完成选择。
主题设置增加失败回滚和启动恢复，避免图片、激活状态与主题名称写入不一致。
统一维护文档中的未完成工作与验收，清理已完成旧项和重复计划。
updates.titleEn: Bing wallpaper cache and theme recovery
itemsEn: Switch to a cached Bing wallpaper immediately and refresh expired images in the background. Closing settings does not cancel the selection.
Recover interrupted theme changes and roll back failed writes without mixing image and activation settings.
Centralize open engineering and verification work, removing completed and duplicate entries.

updates.title: 主题切换与每日壁纸修复
items: Bing 下载与自动刷新完成后不再覆盖后选的主题，下载状态在设置界面持续可见。
经典主题切换立即同步背景、红色对钩和粉色边框，修复无法切回刚才经典主题的问题。
本地上传遵循最新选择；删除正在使用的本地主题后正确恢复默认主题。
updates.titleEn: Theme selection and daily wallpaper fixes
itemsEn: Bing downloads and automatic refreshes no longer override a later theme choice.
Classic backgrounds, checkmarks and borders update together; returning to the previous classic theme works.
Image uploads respect the latest selection, and deleting an active custom theme restores Leaf.

updates.title: 压缩备份与多标签页恢复保护
items: 默认生成无损 Gzip 备份，保留普通 JSON 导出并兼容旧版 JSON 导入。
导出前查看各类数据体积和记录数，可选择是否包含壁纸；导入前明确备份范围。
加强多标签页并发导入、删除和中断恢复保护，自动安全备份始终保留完整内容。
updates.titleEn: Compressed backups and multi-tab recovery
itemsEn: Create lossless Gzip backups, retain plain JSON exports and import older JSON backups.
Review record counts and sizes before export, with an explicit option to omit wallpapers.
Protect concurrent imports, resets and interrupted recovery; automatic safety backups remain complete.

updates.title: 通知面板布局修复
items: 通知面板改为统一滚动，移除空提醒区域的固定占位，更新内容和任务提醒均可完整查看。
修复普通 Chromium 浏览器调整窗口时误用扩展存储接口的报错，保证窗口缩放后继续刷新布局。
保留固定标题，适配较小窗口及页面缩放，通知详情继续支持鼠标和键盘打开。
合并早期 patch.1 的两阶段报告，统一历史文档入口。
updates.titleEn: Notification panel layout fixes
itemsEn: Updates and reminders share a scroll area without a fixed empty spacer.
Browser resizing no longer calls extension-only storage APIs.
Keep headings fixed and support small windows, zoom, mouse and keyboard interaction.
Consolidate the two historical patch.1 phases and documentation links.

updates.title: 多标签页初始化同步修复
items: 修复多个标签页同时打开时，部分页面的任务进度和专注统计未及时刷新的问题。
便携包补齐维护与历史文档，统一文档入口并修正内部链接。
现有任务、专注记录和设置继续保留，默认访问地址不变。
updates.titleEn: Multi-tab initialization fix
itemsEn: Prevent lost focus-record refresh events while another tab is still initializing.
Include maintenance and historical documents in portable archives and correct their links.
Keep existing tasks, focus records, settings and the default address.

updates.title: 多平台启动与便携发布
items: Windows、macOS 和 Linux 现在可以使用统一的启动方式，支持自动打开浏览器、自定义端口及无浏览器模式。
提供 ZIP 和 tar.gz 便携包，解压并安装 Node.js 后即可运行，无需安装应用依赖。
默认访问地址保持不变；升级时使用原有浏览器、主机名和端口即可继续使用本地数据。
updates.titleEn: Cross-platform launcher and portable packages
itemsEn: Use a common launcher on Windows, macOS and Linux, with browser opening, custom ports and headless mode.
Download ZIP or tar.gz packages and run with Node.js; application dependencies do not need installation.
Keep the same browser, hostname and port to retain existing local data.

updates.title: 完成任务白屏修复
items: 修复完成任务或刷新番茄记录时可能出现的白屏与数字格式化报错。
快速重复点击完成按钮只处理一次，避免重复完成任务。
updates.titleEn: Task completion blank-page fix
itemsEn: Handle original focus records safely when rendering task progress.
Ignore repeated completion clicks while the first save is in progress.

updates.title: 深色通知、专注记录与数据重置修复
items: 通知列表、更新详情及本地提示跟随外观的浅色、深色设置。
不足 25 秒的专注不计入历史，短暂停后继续可累计有效时间。
账号导出、导入改为协调的按钮样式，支持键盘操作。
删除数据后恢复本地用户及默认系统清单，修复白屏和旧版空清单。
保留删除前完整备份、等待 5 秒确认和失败回滚。
updates.titleEn: Dark dialogs, focus records and reset fixes
itemsEn: Use the selected light or dark appearance for local notifications and dialogs.
Exclude focus shorter than 25 seconds; valid work can accumulate across short pauses.
Coordinate export and import buttons and support keyboard interaction.
Reset to the local user and default system lists, including recovery of missing navigation lists.
Keep a complete safety backup, five-second confirmation and rollback on failure.

updates.title: 通知中心与本地数据管理更新
items: 更新内容迁入右上角通知铃铛，点击条目查看详情。
关于页移除好评入口，增加 GitHub 仓库链接。
修复删除数据流程：无需密码，等待 5 秒后确认，保存完整备份后重置。
保留已完成的停止、取消任务、后台恢复及数据回滚修复。
版本保留官方 7.1.1，同时标明本地修补版本，方便识别后续更新。
updates.titleEn: Local notifications and data management
itemsEn: Read release details from the notification bell.
Replace rating links with the local GitHub repository link.
Reset data without a password after five-second confirmation, with a complete safety backup.
Keep timer stop, task detachment, background recovery and rollback fixes.
Show both the official base version and the local version.

updates.title: 计时恢复与数据安全修补
items: 后台恢复按实际时间补记全部完整番茄，保存尾数并确认中断时间。
计时会话持久化，记录与进度一起提交，失败回滚并防止重复记录。
修复停止后旧时长恢复、叉号无法取消任务及任务切换问题。
完整备份、导入校验与中断恢复，补齐通知、音频和订阅清理。
updates.titleEn: Timer recovery and durable local data
itemsEn: Recover complete historical focus blocks and retain the remaining partial work after confirmation.
Persist timer sessions and commit records and progress together without duplicates.
Fix stale elapsed time after stopping and incorrect task cancellation or switching.
Validate complete backups, recover interrupted imports, and clean up notifications, audio and subscriptions.
